draftA:
Lesson Plan: Unit Rates with Fractions
Grade 7. Standard 7.RP.A.1: compute unit rates associated with ratios of fractions, including ratios of lengths, areas and other quantities measured in like or different units.
Class: 28 students. 4 need reading support, so all word problems use short sentences.
Total time: 45 minutes (5 + 10 + 10 + 12 + 8).

Warm-up (5 min): Students find the unit rate for 10 miles in 2 hours. Share answers aloud.
Worked example (10 min): Teacher models 1/2 mile in 1/4 hour. Divide: 1/2 divided by 1/4 = 2. Rate is 2 miles per hour.
Guided practice (10 min): Pairs solve two problems. Teacher checks each pair.
Independent practice (12 min): Students solve four problems alone. Reading-support students get the same problems read aloud.
Exit quiz (8 min): 5 questions below.

Quiz
1. A runner goes 1/2 mile in 1/4 hour. Miles per hour?
2. A recipe uses 3/4 cup flour for 1/2 batch. Cups per batch?
3. A painter covers 2/3 wall in 1/3 hour. Walls per hour?
4. Rope: 1/5 kilogram costs 2 dollars. Dollars per kilogram?
5. Paint covers 1/2 square meter with 1/4 liter. Square meters per liter?

Answer Key
1. 2 miles per hour
2. 1 1/2 cups per batch
3. 2 walls per hour
4. 10 dollars per kilogram
5. 2 square meters per liter
draftB:
Grade 7, 45 minutes, standard 7.RP.A.1. Compute unit rates from ratios of fractions, including lengths, areas, and other quantities in like or different units. Class of 28. Four need reading support, so use short sentences. Order: warm-up, worked example, guided practice, independent practice, exit quiz.
Warm-up, 5 min. If 1/2 cup makes 1/4 batch, how much flour for 1 batch? Share briefly.
Worked example, 10 min. A car goes 2/3 mile in 1/4 hour. Divide 2/3 by 1/4. Multiply by the reciprocal. Rate is 8/3 miles per hour.
Guided practice, 10 min. A painter covers 3/4 square foot in 1/2 minute. Find square feet per minute together. Answer: 3/2.
Independent practice, 10 min. Students do two short items: 1/2 liter in 1/5 minute, and 5/6 yard in 1/3 hour. Help readers.
Exit quiz, 10 min.
Quiz. 1. 1/2 mile in 1/4 hour. Miles per hour? 2. 3/4 square foot in 1/2 hour. Square feet per hour? 3. 2/5 cup covers 1/10 wall. Cups per wall? 4. 3/4 km in 1/2 hour. Km per hour? 5. 1/3 meter in 1/6 minute. Meters per minute?
Answer key. Q1: 2 miles per hour. Q2: 3/2 square feet per hour. Q3: 4 cups per wall. Q4: 3/2 km per hour. Q5: 2 meters per minute.

findings.title: Practice problems not included
findings.detail: Guided practice and independent practice assign two and four problems, but those problems are never written. Twenty-two minutes cannot be taught from this plan, and short-sentence compliance cannot be checked.
findings.quote: Pairs solve two problems. Teacher checks each pair.

findings.title: Quiz copies worked example
findings.detail: Question 1 uses the same 1/2 mile in 1/4 hour just modeled, with the answer given as 2. It does not check new learning.
findings.quote: 1. A runner goes 1/2 mile in 1/4 hour. Miles per hour?

reviewOfA.strengths: The plan follows the required five-part sequence, the times add to 45 minutes, and all five quiz answers recompute correctly.

findings.title: Quiz items 2 and 4 duplicate
findings.detail: Q2 and Q4 are the same computation, 3/4 divided by 1/2, both yielding 3/2 per hour. One of the five questions adds no new assessment value; replacing it would widen coverage of like versus different units required by 7.RP.A.1.
findings.quote: 2. 3/4 square foot in 1/2 hour. Square feet per hour? ... 4. 3/4 km in 1/2 hour. Km per hour?

findings.title: Practice and warm-up answers missing
findings.detail: The warm-up and the two independent items have no answers for the teacher. Correct values are 2 cups, 5/2 litres per minute and 5/2 yards per hour. Adding them keeps the 45-minute pacing intact during checking.
findings.quote: Students do two short items: 1/2 liter in 1/5 minute, and 5/6 yard in 1/3 hour. Help readers.

findings.title: Reading support instruction too vague
findings.detail: The class profile names four students needing reading support. "Help readers" gives no concrete action, such as reading items aloud or pairing students. Specify the support so any teacher can deliver it consistently.

reviewOfB.strengths: Every computed rate is correct (8/3, 3/2, and quiz answers 2, 3/2, 4, 3/2, 2), and the five segments total exactly 45 minutes in the department's required order.

merge.document:
Lesson Plan: Unit Rates with Fractions
Grade 7. Standard 7.RP.A.1: compute unit rates associated with ratios of fractions, including ratios of lengths, areas and other quantities measured in like or different units.
Class: 28 students. 4 need reading support. All word problems use short sentences, the teacher reads each item aloud once, and these 4 students are paired with a partner for guided and independent practice.
Total time: 45 minutes (5 + 10 + 10 + 12 + 8). Order: warm-up, worked example, guided practice, independent practice, exit quiz.

Warm-up (5 min): 1/2 cup of flour makes 1/4 batch. Cups per batch? Share answers aloud. Answer: 2 cups per batch.

Worked example (10 min): A car goes 2/3 mile in 1/4 hour. Divide 2/3 by 1/4. Multiply by the reciprocal: 2/3 x 4 = 8/3. Rate is 8/3 miles per hour.

Guided practice (10 min): Pairs solve two problems. Teacher checks each pair.
G1. A painter covers 3/4 square foot in 1/2 minute. Square feet per minute? Answer: 3/2.
G2. A painter covers 2/3 wall in 1/3 hour. Walls per hour? Answer: 2.

Independent practice (12 min): Students solve four problems alone.
I1. 1/2 liter flows in 1/5 minute. Liters per minute? Answer: 5/2.
I2. A snail moves 5/6 yard in 1/3 hour. Yards per hour? Answer: 5/2.
I3. Rope: 1/5 kilogram costs 2 dollars. Dollars per kilogram? Answer: 10.
I4. Paint covers 1/2 square meter with 1/4 liter. Square meters per liter? Answer: 2.

Exit quiz (8 min): 5 questions below.

Quiz
1. A recipe uses 3/4 cup flour for 1/2 batch. Cups per batch?
2. Paint: 2/5 cup covers 1/10 wall. Cups per wall?
3. A beetle walks 1/3 meter in 1/6 minute. Meters per minute?
4. A bus goes 7/8 km in 1/4 hour. Km per hour?
5. Paint covers 3/5 square meter with 1/4 liter. Square meters per liter?

Answer Key
1. 3/4 divided by 1/2 = 3/2 cups per batch
2. 2/5 divided by 1/10 = 4 cups per wall
3. 1/3 divided by 1/6 = 2 meters per minute
4. 7/8 divided by 1/4 = 7/2 km per hour
5. 3/5 divided by 1/4 = 12/5 square meters per liter
merge.keptFromA: From draft A I kept the labelled five-part layout, the 5 + 10 + 10 + 12 + 8 timing, the explicit class-profile line, and the separate numbered quiz and answer key.
merge.keptFromB: From draft B I kept the 2/3 mile in 1/4 hour worked example with the reciprocal step, and its concrete practice items (3/4 square foot in 1/2 minute, 1/2 liter in 1/5 minute, 5/6 yard in 1/3 hour).

resolutions.note: Wrote out two guided items (G1, G2) and four independent items (I1-I4), all in short sentences, with teacher answers.
Dropped the 1/2 mile in 1/4 hour quiz item; the worked example is now 2/3 mile in 1/4 hour and no quiz item repeats it or any practice item.
All five quiz items now use different divisions (3/4 by 1/2, 2/5 by 1/10, 1/3 by 1/6, 7/8 by 1/4, 3/5 by 1/4), covering like units, different units and area.

resolutions.finding: D-B2 Practice and warm-up answers missing
resolutions.note: Added answers to the warm-up (2 cups) and to every guided and independent item, including 5/2 liters per minute and 5/2 yards per hour; both values recompute correctly.

resolutions.finding: D-B3 Reading support instruction too vague
resolutions.note: Replaced "help readers" with a concrete rule: short sentences, teacher reads each item aloud once, and the 4 students are paired with a partner for practice.
